# Workload estimate for the cloud run (generated by cloud/tools/plan_workload.py)

## 1. Performance audit of the Mac runs (from existing logs)

* MacBook Pro, Intel i9-9880H (8 cores / 16 threads), Docker Desktop VM 16 vCPU / 8 GB, bind-mounted project.
* pimpleFoam runs in parallel: mpirun -np 8 (scotch decomposition), one Docker container per command; airwayParcelFoam (particles) runs serially (1 process).
* Medium verification case: 218,220 cells, 29,007 time steps, solver CPU time 23.7 h. A clean machine would have needed about 3.8 h (model fitted on the final phase, when nothing else was running): the run was **6.19x slower than necessary** because particle jobs shared the 8 physical cores and the laptop throttled.
* The same 3-second airflow problem on the coarse mesh took between 778 s and 8189 s for nearly identical work (v001 cases): machine state, not physics, dominates Mac run time.
* Pressure solver: 13.8-42.2 GAMG iterations per step; the low-flow phases need ~3x more iterations per step. This is numerics (fixed tolerances), identical on any machine, and is NOT relaxed.
* Reconstruction: ~4 min per medium case (<2 % of a clean run). Disk: 3.8 GB per medium case (150 binary write times needed by the particle solver); about 0.05 MB/s average write rate - not a bottleneck.
* Airflow reuse is already correct: the 144 baseline particle cases reuse the 9 training airflow solutions; the medium verification run doubles as the production T_N40_SYM case if the medium mesh is adopted.
* Particle runs are serial (1 core each): map (100k parcels) 306 s, direct run (20k) 176 s. Evaluation and recheck stages ran only 2 jobs at a time (now configurable, default unchanged).

## 2. Remaining workload

Airflow cases still needed on the production mesh: 20 (= 19.5 medium-N40-equivalents; flowing phase = 68 % of cost).
Particle runs: 77 response maps, 144 baseline, ~20 recheck, <=153 evaluation runs (all reuse airflow).

| medium | central | 298 | 13 | 4.4 | 5.4 | 5 | 102 |
| medium | pessimistic | 459 | 19 | 6.8 | 7.8 | 7 | 102 |
| fine | optimistic | 1245 | 13 | 6.1 | 15.6 | 14 | 186 |
| fine | central | 2179 | 18 | 10.7 | 26.4 | 25 | 186 |
| fine | pessimistic | 4189 | 28 | 20.6 | 49.8 | 46 | 186 |

Pre-benchmark assumptions (replaced by measured values after the benchmark): c7a per-core speed 1.3-2.8x the Mac (central 2.0x); fine mesh costs 5.8-9.1x a medium case (central 7.3x, measured from the Mac fine run so far: 3.4 h to t = 0.418 s vs 0.46 h for a clean medium case; early-phase ratio, may change later in the cycle); 90 % core utilisation; 85 % MPI efficiency for the longest case.
